provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Terra Mystica rulebook (Feuerland / Z-Man, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Game board in the middle, Cult board next to it
Favor tiles laid out in a 3 x 4 pattern
Scoring tiles in their order; Game end token covering the right half of the uppermost one
An Action token above each of the 6 Power action spaces; the rest beside the board
Workers, Coins and the 10 faceup Town tiles within reach
Bonus cards (scrolls) for your player count
Starting player: whoever most recently dug a planting bed; they take the Starting player token

steps.note: Later games: from the starting player, each chooses a Faction board and side

steps.text: 7 Priests and 3 Bridges next to your Faction board; Structures on their spaces
Markers: Shipping track 0, bottom of the Exchange track, 20 on the Victory point track, 0 on each of the 4 Cult tracks
steps.note: Mermaids start Shipping at 1; Fakirs and Dwarves have no Shipping; Darklings no Exchange marker

steps.text: Take the starting Workers, Coins and Priests shown on your Faction board
Advance on the Cult board once per Cult symbol shown on your Faction board
12 Power tokens split between Bowls I and II as your Faction board shows
Place your starting Dwellings on the map (first game: as the rulebook shows)
Make sure everyone knows the abilities of the factions in play
Round 1 begins with the income phase
